<h2>Translated letter:</h2>

To her lord, or rather her father; to her husband, or rather her brother. This English text should not be extracted.

<h2 class="mt-4">Original letter:</h2>

Domino suo, immo patri; coniugi suo, immo fratri; ancilla sua, immo filia; ipsius uxor, immo soror. Semper valeas qui mihi omnia es.

<h2 class="mt-4">Historical context:</h2>

<p>One of the most celebrated letters of the medieval period.</p>

<h2 class="mt-4">Scholarly notes:</h2>

<p>See <em>The Letters of Abelard and Heloise</em>, trans. Radice.</p>

<h2 class="mt-4">Printed source:</h2>

<em>Historia Calamitatum</em>, ed. Monfrin, Paris 1959.
